annotation.title_clean: DECLARACIÓN DE MONTEVIDEO: Para la construcción de un enfoque regional sobre la gobernanza de la Inteligencia Artificial y sus impactos en nuestra sociedad
annotation.title_en: Montevideo Declaration: Towards a Regional Approach to the Governance of Artificial Intelligence and its Impacts on Our Society
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Second Ministerial and High Authorities Summit on the Ethics of AI in Latin America and the Caribbean (Uruguay, with UNESCO and CAF)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Regional declaration adopted in Montevideo (4 Oct 2024) by Latin American and Caribbean ministers approving a common AI ethics Roadmap with priority areas, consolidating a permanent Working Group and annual ministerial summits, supported by UNESCO and CAF. Rights-centred, non-binding, with no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Approves a regional Roadmap on AI ethics and governance
Priority areas: governance and regulation, talent and future of work, vulnerable groups, environment and climate, infrastructure
Consolidates a permanent Working Group on AI Ethics in LAC, led by Uruguay
Establishes annual Ministerial Summits to follow up the Roadmap
UNESCO and CAF act as technical secretariat; UNESCO RAM diagnostics endorsed
